## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

`compress_topk_cand_buffer_size` sizes the paged BSHD candidate buffer for the single launch that paged K runs.

- `paged=True` (appended, default `False`): full `bs * per_batch_floats` buffer, `microbatch_rows > 0` rejected with the launch's error.
- Same shape as the existing LSE and block-scaled single-launch branches.
- Before: the default `microbatch_rows=-1` sized an auto-microbatch window at `seqlen_q >= 32768`, so a paged launch raised `cand_buffer too small`.
- Docs name both paged sizing calls (BSHD and THD).

## Why

Follow-up to #1823: its last open review comment, [Align paged candidate-buffer sizing with the single-launch path](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/1823#pullrequestreview-5638436322).

## Related issues

Related to #1823.

## API and compatibility impact

- `compress_topk_cand_buffer_size`: optional `paged` appended, dense callers unchanged.

## Testing

- `test_DSA_indexer_forward_paged_declines`: at `bs=2, seqlen_q=32768, seqlen_k=8192, ratio=4` the paged size equals the `microbatch_rows=0` size and exceeds the dense default.
- Same case: `paged=True` with an explicit microbatch raises.
- Paged indexer and compressed top-k suites pass.

detail.title: fix(dsa): size the paged BSHD candidate buffer for a single launch

files.patch:
@@ -560,9 +560,11 @@ which never microbatch, for one full launch.
 Paged K (`block_table` + `kv_lens`, the §3 contract) serves BSHD and THD
 queries with BF16 Q/K in one launch and returns local key ids
 (`topk_indices_global=False`), which is what serving engines consume before
-mapping ids to physical cache rows. THD capture preallocates through
-`compress_topk_cand_buffer_size_thd(cu_seqlens_q, None, ratio, q_causal_offsets)`,
-since a paged pool has no key prefix. No explicit microbatching and no MXFP8
+mapping ids to physical cache rows. Caller-owned candidate buffers are sized
+with `compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(..., paged=True)` for BSHD and
+`compress_topk_cand_buffer_size_thd(cu_seqlens_q, None, ratio, q_causal_offsets)`
+for THD: both return the single-launch size, and the THD call takes no key
+prefix because a paged pool has none. No explicit microbatching and no MXFP8
 yet.
 
 Global versus local ids is primarily an interoperability and allocation

@@ -144,6 +144,7 @@ def compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(
     return_lse: bool = False,
     q_causal_offsets: torch.Tensor | None = None,
     precision: str = "bf16",
+    paged: bool = False,
 ) -> int:
     """Number of float32 elements a caller-provided ``cand_buffer`` must hold for
     ``indexer_fwd_compress_topk`` at this BSHD shape.  It is ``bs * per_batch_floats``; for a
@@ -162,7 +163,11 @@ def compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(
 
     Pass the launch's ``precision``: block-scaled precisions (``"mxfp8"``, ``"mxfp4"``)
     always run a single launch, so this returns the full buffer and an explicit
-    ``microbatch_rows > 0`` raises, as at launch."""
+    ``microbatch_rows > 0`` raises, as at launch.
+
+    Pass ``paged=True`` when the launch reads K through ``block_table`` / ``kv_lens``
+    (``seqlen_k`` is then the launch's ``max_seqlen_k``): paged K also runs a single
+    launch, with the same full-buffer sizing and the same ``microbatch_rows > 0`` error."""
     from ..indexer_top_k.compress_top_k_sm100 import per_batch_floats
 
     _check_q_covered_by_k(seqlen_q, seqlen_k, ratio)
@@ -171,6 +176,10 @@ def compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(
         if microbatch_rows > 0:
             raise NotImplementedError(f"microbatch_rows is not supported with precision={precision!r} " "(per-window scale repacking is not implemented)")
         microbatch_rows = 0
+    if paged:
+        if microbatch_rows > 0:
+            raise NotImplementedError("microbatch_rows > 0 is not supported with paged K; pass microbatch_rows=0")
+        microbatch_rows = 0
     if q_causal_offsets is not None:
         if not q_causal_offsets.is_cuda or q_causal_offsets.dtype != torch.int32 or q_causal_offsets.ndim != 1 or q_causal_offsets.shape[0] != bs:
             raise ValueError(f"q_causal_offsets must be a 1D CUDA int32 tensor of shape ({bs},)")

@@ -303,6 +303,13 @@ def test_DSA_indexer_forward_paged_declines():
         DSA.indexer_forward_top_k_wrapper(q, pool, w, **{**kwargs, "topk_indices_global": True})
     with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="microbatch_rows"):
         DSA.indexer_forward_top_k_wrapper(q, pool, w, microbatch_rows=4, **kwargs)
+    # The BSHD sizing helper follows the same single-launch rule: at a length where the dense default sizes an
+    # auto-microbatch window, paged sizing is the full buffer.
+    full = DSA.compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(2, 32768, 8192, 4, microbatch_rows=0)
+    assert DSA.compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(2, 32768, 8192, 4, paged=True) == full
+    assert DSA.compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(2, 32768, 8192, 4) < full
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="microbatch_rows"):
+        DSA.compress_topk_cand_buffer_size(2, 32768, 8192, 4, microbatch_rows=4096, paged=True)
     with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="BF16"):
         q8, k8 = q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), pool.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
         sf = torch.ones((1, 128, 4), device=device).to(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
